about: Trident Limited manufactures, trades, and sells textiles, Yarn, paper, chemicals, and energy in India, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Yarn, Towel, Bedsheets, Paper and Chemicals. The company offers cotton combed, open-end, air jet, organic cotton, core spun, blended, eli-twist, slub, compact, air-rich, certified cotton, mélange, packed dye, zero twist, and dyed yarns; and home textiles, including bath and bed linen products.
